content: Adafeɛ n Bulus x yixef nnes zzat i ujeǧid Aɣripas
Xas uca inna Aɣripas i Bulus: “Cek ɣarek ttesriḥ ḥima ad tessiwřed x yixef nnec!” Xenni isswiẓẓeḍ Bulus afus nnes uca iwta x yixef nnes, inna:
“Di marra min xef d ayi ḍeřmen Wudayen, a ajeǧid Aɣripas, ḥessbeɣ ixef inu d bnadem d amimun, aqa ass-a zemmareɣ ad wteɣ x yixef inu qibač nnec.
Deg umezwaru s minzi aqa cek tessned mliḥ marra ixarwiḍen d izerfan n Wudayen. S uyenni ttareɣ zzayek ad ayi tesřed s ttasiɛ n řxaḍar.
Minzi Udayen, iwa, mařa xsen ad cehden waha x man aya, ssnen abrid n tudart inu mliḥ zi temẓi inu, am mammec t tuɣa zeg umezwaru jar řgens inu u di Urcalim.
Nitni ssnen ayi mliḥ aṭṭas zeg wami, ssnen aqa tuɣa ddareɣ ɛlaḥsab taɣuri nican n Ifarisiyyen.
U řexxu beddeɣ danita, ttwaḥakameɣ di ṭṭweɛ n usitem n lwaɛd i zi iwaɛd AREBBI i řejdud nneɣ.
Maɣar wa d asitem nni ttrajant tenɛac n tqebbař nneɣ ad ɣares dd-awḍent, am ssgeɛɛdent tiẓaǧitin yuǧɣen ǧiřet d wass. Di ṭṭweɛ n usitem-a, a ajeǧid Aɣripas, ḍeřmen ayi Wudayen.
Mammec tḥekkmem kenniw? Ma war ittxeṣṣa ad namen belli AREBBI ad issnekkar-dd imettinen?
Zic tuɣa zeɛmeɣ nican, aqa ittxeṣṣa ad ggeɣ aṭṭas n tmesřayin ḍidd i Yisem n Yasuɛ Nnaṣiri.
Uca aya i ggiɣ ɛawed di Urcalim. Am ṭṭfeɣ tizemmar zi jjihet n imeqqranen n ikehhanen, ḥebbseɣ aṭṭas n imqeddasen. Uca řami ttwanɣen zzaysen, tuɣa areṭṭiɣ s man aya ak-d inni xas iḥekmen.
Ɛedbeɣ ten di marra timzidawin, ggiɣ xasen uɣiř maḥend ad ceqqfen Isem n Yasuɛ. Tuɣa tthajeɣ xasen aṭṭas u tuɣa ggureɣ ɣar tneddam inneɣni maḥend ad ten marrteɣ.
Řami tuɣa ggureɣ ɣar Dimacq zi ssibbet nni s ṣṣulṭa d ttesriḥ zi jjihet n imeqqranen n ikehhanen,
xenni, a ajeǧid, umi tuɣa ayi deg webrid, ẓriɣ ict n tfawt zeg ujenna ɣar wezyen n wass, tᵉttissiqq ktar zi tfuct, tenneḍ ayi-dd u i yinni akidi imsafaren.

Neccin newḍa marra di temmurt, sřiɣ i ict n tmijja tessawař-dd akidi, teqqar s Tɛibranit: ‘Cawul, Cawul, mayemmi xafi tdarrced? Aqa tarenyed tzeyyared x yixef nnec umi cek teccated awarni ac di sřek n buykucḍan.’
Nniɣ: ‘Min teɛnid Cek, a Sidi?’ Inna Siditneɣ: ‘Necc d Yasuɛ Annaṣiri, wenni tmarrted.’
Xenni inna ayi: ‘Kkar, tbedded x iḍaren nnec, minzi i uya i d ac dd-ḍhareɣ ḥima ad cek arecḥḥeɣ d amsexxar d acehhad, aqa umi d ayi teẓrid u aqa ad ayi tẓared ɛawed.
Ad fekkeɣ cek zeg weydud n Wudayen u zi řegnus nneɣni i ɣar cek ɣa ssekkeɣ,
ḥima ad tarezmed tiṭṭawin nsen, ḥima ad tuben zi taǧest ɣar tfawt u zi ṣṣulṭa n cciṭan ɣar AREBBI, u ad ṭṭfen aɣfar n ddnub d ict n tesɣart n řwart jar imqeddasen s l’iman i dayi iǧan.’
S uyenni, a ajeǧid Aɣripas, war ɛekkseɣ ca řewḥiy nni ẓriɣ zeg ujenna,

maca ɣar umezwar bdiɣ ad barrḥeɣ s Řexbar Aṣebḥan i yinni iǧan di Dimacq d Urcalim u i marra inni izeddɣen di dcurat n Yahudiyya, uca xenni barrḥeɣ ɛawed i řegnus ḥima ad tuben ad dewřen ɣar AREBBI, ad ggen řexdayem i ittřiqen i ttubet.
S uyenni ṭṭfen ayi Wudayen di Zzawect Tameqqrant uca xsen ad ayi nɣen.

Maca AREBBI iwca ayi afus ař ass-a, u xzar, aqa beddeɣ da zzat i umeẓyan d umeqqran, war qqareɣ walu i dd-itteffɣen zi Ccariɛa n Musa d Inabiyyen, mɣir timesřayin waha nni zi qqaren nitni aqa ad iřint,
belli tuɣa ittxeṣṣa i Lmasiḥ ad iweddeb u belli Netta ad yiři d Amenzu n Tnukra zi taddart n imettinen, ad ibarreḥ s Tfawt i řgens-a u i řegnus marra.”
Awarni řami idafeɛ Bulus s yixef nnes ammu, inna Fastus s jjehd: “Aqa cek d abuhaři, a Bulus. Aṭṭas n tɣuri tessbuhři i cek.”
Maca Bulus inna as: “Necc war ttwaxeřfeɣ ca, a sidi Fastus yuɛřan, aqa qqareɣ awařen n tidett, daysen řaman.
Uřa d ajeǧid Aɣripas issen mliḥ x tmesřayin-a. S uyenni ssawařeɣ s teryast minzi ittřiɣ ayi belli uřa d ict n řḥajjet zi tmesřayin-a aqa tennuffar xas, minzi marra man aya war imsar di tnuffra.
Ma tumned zeg inabiyyen, a ajeǧid Aɣripas? Necc ssneɣ belli tumned zzaysen.”
Maca Aɣripas inna as: “Mɣir s drus tessqenɛed ayi ḥima ad dewřeɣ d amasiḥi.”
Inna as Bulus: “Ttareɣ AREBBI belli deɣya u i waṭṭas, war iǧi cek waha, maca uřa d marra inni d ayi ittesřan ass-a, ad dewřen am necc, maca břa iceddiyyen-a.”
Ikkar ujeǧid d lɛamil d Barniki d marra inni tuɣa akidsen iqqimen,
uca ffɣen ssenni am ssawařen ak-d wayawya, nnan jar asen: “Aryaz-a war iggi ca min isdaheǧen řmewt uřa d iceddiyyen.”
Inna Aɣripas i Fastus: “Maɛlik war tuɣi issgeɛɛed ddeɛwet nnes ɣar qayṣar, iři aqa ittwaḍřeq bnadem-a.”
